title: Law to set default due dates for city reports
summary: This bill would amend the New York City Charter to create a default schedule for when city agencies must submit periodic reports to the Council if no specific due date is set in law. Reports covering less than a year would be due at the end of the following month, and reports covering a year or more would be due at the end of the second following month. It would also standardize how terms like month, quarter, half-year and fiscal year are interpreted in reporting requirements.
